name: What is the process for replacing bedroom windows with City Dweller, LLC?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for replacing bedroom windows with City Dweller, LLC?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with a free consultation to discuss your needs and provide a detailed estimate. Once you approve, we'll measure your windows and order the selected products. Our skilled installers will then carefully remove your old windows, prepare the opening, install the new windows, and seal them properly. We ensure a clean worksite and perform a final inspection to guarantee satisfaction. We handle permits and ensure compliance with local regulations in Bay Area cities like Pacifica or Daly City.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes consultation, measurement, ordering, professional installation, clean-up, and a final inspection, including permit handling.
